name: @repo/native
description: Tauri 2 shell for desktop (Windows/macOS/Linux) and mobile (Android/iOS). Wraps the static build of @repo/web; no IPC.

scripts.android:build: bun scripts/tauri-config.ts --release && tauri android build --config tauri.build.conf.json
scripts.ios:build: bun scripts/tauri-config.ts --release && tauri ios build --config tauri.build.conf.json
